headline: Tuesday: ALCS Game 2 (Guardians lead the Rays 1-0), a 16-game NHL card, and two Tuesday-night college games. Champions League kicked off before noon PT, there's no NFL or WNBA tonight, and no golf until Thursday.

record.label: Last board (Mon 10/12)
record.note: Props went 4-0; both sides lost (the Bills won 37-34 in OT). Tue 10/6 went 8-11 (-1.59u). Running total: 40-41-1, +2.30u. A few props couldn't be confirmed from box scores and are left ungraded.

notes: Player props are the board's best category so far, so tonight leans on them. Sides and totals have been roughly break-even or worse.
Still no game totals. They're 0-7 since the first board.
Prices marked 'estimate' are converted from prediction-market percentages. Check your book before betting.
No bet is a lock. Confidence runs 1–5, and nothing tonight is above a 3.

sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: Mostly props tonight, since they've been the board's most reliable category.

straight.reasoning: Edmonton is 4-0-1 and Los Angeles is 0-2-2. numberFire gives the Oilers a 58.8% chance to win, which is worth about -143, so -132 is slightly cheap. McDavid and Draisaitl have driven the offense from the start; Draisaitl scored twice in the 9-7 win at Vancouver earlier this month. Playable to -140.

Cleveland starts lefty Parker Messick, who has a 5.40 ERA and six walks in 6.2 postseason innings and hasn't gotten through five innings in either start. numberFire puts the Rays at 60%. Last night's Rays pick lost when Cleveland's bullpen took over late, so this is 0.75u. Playable to -145.

parlay.title: Shot Volume Trio
parlay.reasoning: Three shot props from three different games, each built on volume: McMann has cleared 2.5 in all six games, Kindel cleared 1.5 in 17 of his last 20 games with 15+ minutes, and MacKinnon averages 4.6 shots. Pays roughly 6-to-1. McMann and Kindel prices are estimates.

parlay.title: Late Favorites
parlay.reasoning: Two favorites that are priced a bit below what the models give them. Pays about 2.4-to-1.

props.pick: Bobby McMann OVER 2.5 shots on goal
props.reasoning: McMann has cleared 2.5 shots in all six games this season and averages 6.3 shot attempts. Nearly half his shots come from the slot, and the Flyers rank last in slot shots allowed. Plus money for something that's happened every game. Price is an estimate from a 48% market.

props.pick: Nathan MacKinnon OVER 3.5 shots on goal
props.reasoning: MacKinnon has 23 shots in five games (4.6 per game) and averaged 4.38 a game over 80 games last season. He plays heavy minutes and runs the first power-play unit. Playable to -130.

That's fewer than 5 innings. Messick has gone 4.1 and 2.1 innings in his two postseason starts, with six walks. Cleveland's bullpen just won Game 1 for them, so the Guardians will go to it early again.

sections.label: Baseball
sections.slate: ALCS Game 2: Guardians @ Rays at 5:00 PM PT (Cleveland leads 1-0 after winning 7-3). Parker Messick starts for Cleveland; FanDuel lists Freddy Peralta for Tampa Bay. No NLCS game today.

straight.reasoning: Messick has a 5.40 postseason ERA and six walks in 6.2 innings. Tampa Bay won 98 games, and numberFire has the Rays at 60%. Playable to -145.

parlay.title: Messick Exits Early (SGP)
parlay.reasoning: If Tampa Bay gets to Messick early, he's out of the game and the Rays are probably ahead — the two outcomes go together. Books price that correlation in.

props.reasoning: He went 4.1 and 2.1 innings in his two postseason starts and has walked six batters. Under 5 innings is the expected outcome.
Díaz has a hit in every postseason game, went 2-for-5 with a run in Game 1, and is 3-for-11 with a double against Messick. A single plus a run or RBI clears it.

sections.label: Football
sections.slate: Tuesday college football: Delaware @ Middle Tennessee (4:00 PM PT), FIU vs Jacksonville State (5:00 PM PT). No NFL until Thursday.

straight.reasoning: Delaware has flipped from a 1.5-point underdog to a 1.5-point road favorite even though starting QB Nick Minicucci is out for the season and the team just lost 42-3 and 30-14. Action Network's staff fades Delaware here. MTSU is bad too (shut out 55-0 by Kansas), so this is a half unit.

sections.label: Soccer
sections.slate: Nothing bettable pregame. Today's Champions League and Championship matches kicked off before noon PT.

sections.label: Hockey
sections.slate: 16 games. The early ones (Panthers @ Blue Jackets at 3:15 PT, Kraken @ Flyers at 4:00, Lightning @ Rangers at 4:15) start soonest. The late game is Oilers @ Kings at 7:30.

straight.reasoning: Edmonton is 4-0-1 and Los Angeles is 0-2-2. numberFire's 58.8% win probability is worth about -143. Playable to -140.

Vegas played last night in Minnesota and lost 4-2, so this is the second night of a back-to-back on the road. numberFire gives Nashville 53.4% (worth about -115), but they're priced as an underdog. Nashville took 4 of 6 points on its last road trip.

parlay.title: Fade the Tired Team + Oilers
parlay.reasoning: Both legs are priced below their model win probabilities. Pays about 3.8-to-1.

parlay.title: Avs Top Line (SGP)

legs.pick: Nathan MacKinnon OVER 3.5 shots on goal

parlay.reasoning: MacKinnon has 10 points in five games. When he's shooting at a high rate, he's usually producing points too. The point price is an estimate, and the book will discount this correlated parlay.

props.pick: Bobby McMann OVER 2.5 shots on goal
props.reasoning: 6-for-6 on this line this season, 6.3 shot attempts per game, and the Flyers give up the most slot shots in the league. Price is an estimate.

props.pick: Nathan MacKinnon OVER 3.5 shots on goal
props.reasoning: 4.6 shots per game this season and 4.38 last season, with 4+ in three of his last five. Playable to -130.

props.pick: Ben Kindel OVER 1.5 shots on goal
props.reasoning: He's cleared 1.5 shots in 17 of his last 20 games when playing 15+ minutes (85%), and he's played 17+ minutes in four straight. Chicago is 29th in shots allowed per 60. Price is an estimate from a 60% market.
Four assists in four games and 59 assists last season. Columbus generates the most scoring chances with him on the ice. This one starts at 3:15 PT, so bet it first. Price is an estimate.

props.pick: Dylan Guenther OVER 3.5 shots on goal
props.reasoning: Guenther averages 3.67 shots and has gone over 3.5 in four of six games. Toronto is 28th in shots allowed and gives up 8.3 shots a game to right wingers. Price is an estimate.

Four goals in five games, and he leads Tampa Bay in scoring chances. The Rangers are down to their third goalie, Dylan Garand, with Shesterkin out for the season and Korpisalo also out. A long shot, so a quarter unit. Price is an estimate.

sections.label: Golf
sections.slate: No tournament today. Last week, Jacob Bridgeman (our Top 10 pick) finished T2 and Michael Brennan won the Baycurrent Classic.

sections.label: Basketball
sections.slate: No games worth betting. The WNBA Finals (Valkyries vs Dream) start Saturday at 12:30 PM PT. NBA preseason is skipped.
